integrity: The proof uses a Legendre integration recurrence, a positive Jacobi quadratic form and Dirichlet Airy variational convergence; the accompanying finite computations are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Only the stated asymptotic limit on unweighted L2(0,1) is proved. The o(n^{-5/3}) term is not uniformly bounded at finite n; no claims for other weights or bases. The full 1996 article was not accessible; mathematical priority remains subject to independent literature review.
title: An Airy edge correction for Legendre compression of the Volterra operator
